mutations.name: drop-backpressure
mutations.why: Produce no longer waits for room in the queue (the capacity guard removed): the queue outgrows Cap.

mutations.name: batch-reordered
mutations.why: The batcher prepends instead of appending, so items leave a batch in reverse order.

mutations.name: remove-fairness
mutations.why: Without WF on Next the pipeline may stop before everything is delivered, so AllDelivered must fail by stuttering.
